required_outcomes: Recognises the switch did not fix the kitchen fan (light works, motor only hums), so a contractor is likely needed and the job stays open.
Goes back to the landlord with the result of his suggestion and asks for approval to send a contractor (or whether he will use his own), since his earlier reply was a tip, not an approval.
Handles the bathroom extractor as its own issue (a separate job or included explicitly in the landlord approval request), not lost in the reply.
Replies to the tenant: the kitchen fan is going back to the landlord for a contractor, the bathroom extractor has been logged, and an honest answer on the window cleaner without inventing a date.
acceptable_alternatives: Combining both extractors in one approval request to the landlord, provided each is named.
Asking the tenant for a short video or photo of the humming fan alongside the landlord request.
positive_behaviours: Advises the tenant not to keep running the humming fan, as a stalled motor can overheat.
Notes that the window cleaning question is outside this repair and who it was passed to.
red_flags: Assigning a contractor without the landlord's approval.
prohibited_actions: Inventing a window cleaner visit date.
critical_failures: Closing the kitchen fan job when the tenant says the fan still does not spin.
